context: 2.1 Dosage The dosage in adults (18 years and older) and pediatric patients (≥12 years of age and weighing at least 40 kg) is bebtelovimab 175 mg. Administer bebtelovimab as soon as possible after positive results of direct SARS-CoV-2 viral testing and within 7 days of symptom onset.
